# Face Audit

> Free satirical face roast. Upload a selfie, get a score card, challenge a friend. Pure entertainment. Nothing leaves the device.

- Site: https://faceaudit.jonbailey.xyz/
- Version: 4.1.0 The Calipers
- Author: Pitchfork-and-Torch
- Hub: https://jonbailey.xyz/
- X: https://x.com/suddenlyjon

## One liner

Client-only selfie roast cards. Pin keepers to The Calipers. Stochastic calipers, not science.

## Quick answers

Q: What is Face Audit?
A: A free satirical face-roast page. You capture or upload a selfie and get a shareable score card.

Q: Does my photo leave this device?
A: No. Capture, scoring, and card export stay in the browser. Nothing is uploaded.

Q: Is this medical or scientific?
A: No. Not medical advice, not a diagnosis, not a beauty standard. Satire only.

Q: Is it free?
A: Yes. No account. No paywall.

Q: What is The Calipers?
A: A local pin list of roast cards. Pins stay in this browser. No photos stored.

Q: Does it measure my face?
A: No. The score is a seeded random roast. Local crop size, luma, and optional face box are photo geometry, not bone, not medical.

## Constraints

- EN-only while fleet i18n is paused.
- Do not invent clinical claims or stored-photo statements.
- Scores stay stochastic. Local numbers are crop/pixels only.
